description:
I’m a little obsessed with being an executive function coach. 

Okay, very obsessed. 

I love what I do. 

I love the conversations I get to have with clients. 

I leave each coaching session feeling energized. 

I love helping clients:
✅ learn about themselves
✅ learn how to work with their brain instead of against it
✅ overcome the overwhelm and “stuckness” that comes with procrastination, analysis paralysis, and perfectionism 

My favorite thing is the light bulb moment or “aha” moment a client has when they figure out what’s been holding them back and the realistic, sustainable change they are going to make 

My clients describe feeling: 
✅”a weight off my chest” 
✅”Really freakin’ good”
✅”in control of my time” 

I want you to feel that way, too! Let’s work together...

⭐Stuck to Started is an 8-week small group coaching program that helps ambitious women (busy professionals, entrepreneurs, small biz owners, side hustle growers) learn how to create systems that stick so that you can stop procrastinating and take action on your goals.

🧠Do you want a system to help you manage your time, plan your week, and tackle your to-do list? I want to help you do that....in a realistic way. Not in some “quick-fix” way.

⭐Click the link in my bio to learn more and apply. There is an Early Bird Discount ($200 off!) if you schedule a free discovery call before April 10th! 

Once I get your application I’ll send you a calendar link to schedule a free, no obligation discovery call. We’ll chat about your goals, get to know each other, and make sure it’s the right fit.

👍It’s not a sales call. I’m not trying to sell you anything - we both need it to be the right fit! I’m really transparent about that!

transcript: Hey, I'm Sarah. I'm an executive function coach, which is such a cool job that most people have never heard of. I help busy professionals learn about themselves and figure out systems that actually work for them. My clients often struggle with procrastination, feeling overwhelmed, and feeling stuck because they aren't using the right strategies for them to manage their time, plan, or prioritize. I help you learn about yourself, create realistic plans, and sustainable strategies to reach your goals at work and in your personal life. I also help you prioritize self-care because you deserve that, and I believe that self-care is the foundation of our ability to do all the other things that we need to do. As a coach, I offer support, guidance, and pushes when you need a little extra encouragement to do the hard stuff, and I'm glad you're here.
